rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates multiple static analysis tools into a single MCP interface for AI coding agents, surfacing only newly introduced violations relative to a stored baseline. Includes custom detectors for dead database columns, orphaned i18n keys, and unused CSS selectors. Generates digest-based quality reports for AI code review workflows.
